title: Screen fading
description: This is a resource packs which makes screen fading possible like on MCCIsland.
body:
## Screen Fading

**Screen Fading** is a lightweight resource pack that adds a custom oversized black character designed for title overlays, allowing you to simulate smooth fade-to-black screen transitions.

Perfect for servers, maps, and plugins that need clean visual transitions without mods.

### ✨ Features

* Large black glyph for full-screen fade effects
* Works with `/title` and compatible plugins
* Smooth transition feel for cutscenes and UI moments
* Minimal and performance-friendly

### 🛠️ Use Cases

* Cinematic transitions
* Teleport effects
* Cutscenes and intros


### 📦 How to Use

Use the custom character in a `/title` command or through a plugin to display it on screen. Adjust fade timings to achieve the desired transition effect.

### 🛠️ Examples
Teleports:
```
/title @s times 1 1 1
/title @s title ""
```
Intros
```
/title @s times 1 3 1
/title @s title ""
```

### ⚠️ Notes

* Requires correct font usage (included in the pack)
* Designed for servers and mapmakers
